field_notes: Vultr prepaid-card field test (2026-11-13/14): prepaid at $0 fails -> account SUSPENSION (recoverable), not deletion; stopped instances keep billing (no pause); snapshots keep billing after destroy ($0.05/GB-mo compressed); pending charges post in batches, not per-hour.
OCI Always Free is the only big-cloud tier this stack verified by actually USING it: 2x E2.1.Micro + 200GB boot volumes, zero charges, 100+ days.
NVIDIA NIM free keys are per-account daily-token pools for prototyping — fine for a single developer, not a multi-tenant backend (see free-router lesson).
anti_hallucination: every offer carries a verbatim page quote, validated against the fetched text at extraction time; offers without a matching quote are dropped, never stored
